title: Lag test on your phone, 10 min, after the next push: ⚙ (top right of Home) → 🛠 Dev → Start lag test. Copy the prompt into your Claude chat first.
prompt:
Lag test for Knowitball (B18). Merge main into my branch first.
I'm going to run the in-game Lag test on my phone now. Walk me through it one step at a time, short and plain:
1. Open knowitball.co.uk/star-dev on my phone, signed in. ⚙ (top right of Home) → 🛠 Dev → Start lag test.
2. Pick my device on the first screen (iPhone 16 or newer / iPhone 13 or 14 / older Android / a PC tier) and my name.
3. Follow the pill at the top: go to each screen it names, tap "I'm there", wait for "Done, tap Next", tap Next. Skip any step I can't reach.
4. At the end, screenshot the ✓/✗ table. It sends itself; if it says it didn't, tap "Send again".
When I say done, run `npx tsx scripts/lag-runs.mts` and tell me: my run is saved (yes/no), my device, and each step that failed with its numbers.
If it says "Saved on this device only", tell me to tap "Copy results" and paste them into the Team chat instead.
Don't change any game code for this.

title: Read the Brain rules (new: CLAUDE.md shrunk)
prompt:
The Brain arrived (Harry, 21 Oct 2026). Do this once, in this chat:
1. Merge main into my branch.
2. If CLAUDE.md clashes: take the NEW short version from main. If my branch added history or notes to CLAUDE.md since 20 Oct, move those lines into SESSION_LOG.md (newest first, word for word). If my branch added a standing rule, make it a Brain note instead (step 4).
3. Read kits/brain-kit/SEARCH.md and kits/brain-kit/README.md. From now on, search brain/_index.md before reading long documents, and cite the note code (e.g. RUL-TEAM-001) when you answer.
4. New facts and rules go in brain/ notes, never in CLAUDE.md. A note is brain/<type>/<CODE>.md:
   ---
   id: RUL-ENG-009            (type RUL/FACT/PRO/DEC/REF - area ALL/ENG/3D/UI/CAR/ECO/MED/DAT/ADM/TEAM - next free number)
   type: ruling               (ruling | fact | process | decision | reference)
   client: eng                (all, eng, 3d, ui, car, eco, med, dat, adm or team)
   tags: []                   (leave empty; the script fills it)
   status: live
   date: 2026-10-21
   source: "path/to/file.md:56"   (the exact line or range that says it)
   summary: One plain sentence under 20 words with the word people will search for.
   ---
   A changed rule gets a NEW note; set the old one to status: superseded and superseded_by: NEW-CODE. Never reuse a code.
5. After any note change run: python3 scripts/brain/build_index.py   It must end with errors=0. An ERROR about a source line means the line moved or no longer says it: fix the line number (scripts/brain/make_notes.py with a spec in scripts/brain/specs/ finds lines by their text).
6. Commit and push my own branch. Tell me in plain English what you merged and moved.

title: Set your Claude connector permissions: look-only = Always allow, changes = Needs approval, deletes = Never
prompt:
Set my Claude connector permissions (Harry, 24 Oct 2026). Do this once, in this chat:
1. git fetch origin Harry && git checkout origin/Harry -- scripts/connectors   (the page maker and Harry's rules; don't commit these files to my branch).
2. List every connector tool loaded in THIS chat (my own claude.ai connectors), grouped by connector. Write them to scripts/connectors/tools-mikey.json in the same shape as scripts/connectors/tools.json (connector name -> space-separated tool names). Check each connector's count against what's really loaded; no guessed tools.
3. Run: python3 scripts/connectors/permissions-page.py <your scratchpad>/perm-mikey.html scripts/connectors/tools-mikey.json "Mikey's Connector Permissions"
4. Publish that page as an artifact and give me the link.
The rules (same as Harry's): look-only tools = Always allow; anything that changes, sends, spends or publishes = Needs approval; anything that wipes data in bulk, takes the site down or can't be undone (pause/restore/create project, bucket/page/database deletes) = Never.
Don't change any setting yourself: I set them in claude.ai -> Settings -> Connectors -> each connector -> Tool permissions. The quick way per connector: Read-only group = Always allow (one tap), Write/delete group stays Needs approval, then tap Never on the red rows.
Harry's own page, for reference: https://claude.ai/artifact/FF8yu78LBivtWiCCvouM8N
